Message:
scsi: mpi3mr: Support SAS transport class callbacks

Add support for the following SAS transport class callbacks:

 - get_linkerrors
 - get_enclosure_identifier
 - get_bay_identifier
 - phy_reset
 - phy_enable
 - set_phy_speed
 - smp_handler
